title: Hardware Wallet Firms Warn of Phishing Surge as Coldcard Losses Near $130M
text: Title: Hardware Wallet Firms Warn of Phishing Surge as Coldcard Losses Near $130M. Summary: Fake "coordinated hardware audit" emails are steering holders to a cloned Coldcard site that installs remote-access software.

title: Five Convicted of Imprisoning Crypto Millionaires in London 'Torture' Ordeal
text: Title: Five Convicted of Imprisoning Crypto Millionaires in London 'Torture' Ordeal. Summary: Two of the five were also convicted of conspiracy to blackmail, in a case police won without either victim testifying.

title: Marmot Researchers Turn to OnlyFans for Funding—And There Are Meme Coins Too
text: Title: Marmot Researchers Turn to OnlyFans for Funding—And There Are Meme Coins Too. Summary: Scientists are using OnlyFans to help fund decades of marmot research, while unofficial memecoins inspired by the project have emerged on Solana.

title: Former FBI Agent Charged With Stealing Nearly $1 Million in Crypto and Using ChatGPT for Investment Advice
text: Title: Former FBI Agent Charged With Stealing Nearly $1 Million in Crypto and Using ChatGPT for Investment Advice. Summary: Prosecutors say the former counterintelligence supervisor stole cryptocurrency from wallets tied to FBI investigations before asking ChatGPT how to invest the money and relocate to Europe.

title: What Is an Air-Gapped Bitcoin Wallet? Why the Coldcard Exploit Changes the Conversation About Offline Security
text: Title: What Is an Air-Gapped Bitcoin Wallet? Why the Coldcard Exploit Changes the Conversation About Offline Security. Summary: Air-gapped wallets keep private keys completely offline, reducing exposure to hackers—but they're not immune from threats.

title: BlackRock Launches Tokenized Money Market Funds on Solana, Ethereum
text: Title: BlackRock Launches Tokenized Money Market Funds on Solana, Ethereum. Summary: BlackRock launched a tokenized money market fund for stablecoin reserves that uses Solana alongside Ethereum.

title: XRP Holders Can Now Borrow Ripple's RLUSD on Ethereum Without Selling Their Crypto
text: Title: XRP Holders Can Now Borrow Ripple's RLUSD on Ethereum Without Selling Their Crypto. Summary: Flare's FXRP has been approved as collateral in a $280 million RLUSD lending vault, allowing XRP holders to tap Ethereum's lending markets.
